newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Owens reaps NZ$14.3 mln from CHEP stake.
newsitem.headline: Owens reaps NZ$14.3 mln from CHEP stake.

text.p: Owens Group Ltd said the sale of its 34.43 percent shareholding in CHEP New Zealand to Brambles Australia Ltd was settled on Thursday for a net sum of NZ$14.3 million.

Owens said the transaction was a sale of its shares in its subsidiary companies Union Airways and Porter Square for a consideration of $17.19 million which was satisfied in cash. As a condition of the sale Owens had repaid net advances to it of $2.88 million.
Transport group Brambles said on July 8 it had acquired 100 percent of the CHEP New Zealand pallet rental business from Freightways Ltd and the Owens Group.
Brambles said the purchase would result in a more efficient trans-Tasman pallet pool and would be a significant additional revenue source for the pallet division.
